Bibliography

Projects, Presentations, Publications, and Workshops

A reference catalogue of professional work for applied data-science roles. Projects selects and elaborates on evidence relevant to a particular bid; this catalogue also retains work not used in that narrative.

Public Project Repositories

Data Architecture and Pipelines

Repository Description
absent-from-chronic Collaborative CCHS study of chronic conditions and work absenteeism: reproducible data preparation, validation, statistical modeling, and reporting. Research in progress; survey microdata are not public. Analysis site · Research proposal.
quick-start-template Reusable project framework; standardized organization, version control, and documentation for analytic projects. Adopted across 32 repositories in the branch. AI support system · Design principles.
caseload-forecast-demo Public forecasting demonstration: seasonal ARIMA and baseline comparison, holdout validation, versioned data lineage, and Parquet artifacts. Learning sandbox, not production or cloud deployment; forecasts reflect its data snapshot. Forecast site · Project summary.
books-of-ukraine Cross-domain data pipeline exploring Ukrainian publishing trends (2005–present). Four-stage Ellis pipeline, multilingual data handling, SQLite databases, research group collaboration (4 contributors). Demonstrates portability of the Ferry/Ellis architecture outside government.
service-system-sim Simulated service system ontology preserving structural properties of real administrative data while being entirely privacy-safe. Enables external collaboration and cloud-based development.

Capacity Building and Teaching

Repository Description
aim-2025-sandbox Sandbox for the AIM (AI Maximalists) initiative, Cohort II, Alberta Technology and Innovation. AI-enhanced research analytics with persona-based context system, composing and publishing orchestration.
HIM6217-21S Graduate course: Health Care Database Management (UCF, Spring 2021). SQL curriculum with 6 progressive homework assignments, synthetic health databases (CMS SynPUFs), SQLite.
hsa6752-spring-2020 Graduate course: Health Care Analytics (UCF, Spring 2020). Covers Tableau, SAS, and R for health data wrangling, statistical modeling, and data visualization.

Enterprise Projects (Government of Alberta)

The following repositories are maintained behind the Government of Alberta enterprise firewall. They are listed here to document the scope and nature of applied analytics work; no URLs are available.

FIESTA stands for Financial Impact of Employment Services and Training in Alberta. It uses linked administrative and Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) tax records to estimate the income effects of employment services and training. FIESTA 2.0 extends the work to a larger, multi-program cohort.

Repository Description
sda-research-db ETL infrastructure connecting 15+ raw administrative tables to a SQL Server-based research warehouse; supports 18+ analysis notebooks across all branch projects.
sda-fiesta Original quasi-experimental net impact analysis of 88K Income Support clients linked to CRA tax records; propensity score weighting estimating $600–$2,400 income gains per participant, varying by service type.
sda-fiesta-2 Expanded cohort (734K individuals); 3-stage pipeline processing 8.6M+ records into 14 versioned CSVs for model estimation across IS, AISH, and CEIS programs.
sda-open-data Automated Income Support Caseload pipeline for the Alberta Open Data portal; first fully scripted replacement of manual Excel/Word publication process.
sda-worp-monthly Monthly WORP pipeline with nonresponse reweighting and anomaly alerts; co-developed with branch colleagues.
sda-era-segmentation Weekly NAP and bi-weekly A2 reporting for Employment Services; AI-transparent development process.
sda-senior-forecasting ASB forecasting using StatCan population projections; onboarded into the Quick-Start Template paradigm.
sda-forecasting-1 Production IS caseload forecasting system; RDB ferry pipeline established March 2026.
sda-ceis-impact Standardized net impact assessment pipeline using ALSS-only data; operational platform for Value for Money reporting.
